quote: This is the most immersive and fun game I've ever played. KCD1 had me so invested in the story, and getting to see the end of it was one of the most satisfying feelings I've felt from a game in a long time

author: Pugz00
quote:
This game is okay, it has some fun parts, some boring parts but it's not doing anything new. Unfortunately price has to be taken into account, and when you'rs charging 50% more than any other game for okay, it's not worth the money. Ripping out content and locking it behind DLC is also unacceptable, 30 fps is not great and it can be felt, and the game has some severe bugs. 

Again, the issue is, when you're charging this price for a game I expect a lot more for my time and money.
